DIAGNOSIS READY: Jersey Finger (Avulsion fracture of the Flexor Digitorum Profundus tendon at the FDP insertion).

Based on the history of the finger being caught in a jersey, the specific X-ray finding of an avulsed bony fragment from the volar plate, and the inability to actively fully flex the distal phalanx, the diagnosis is a Jersey finger. Surgical repair is typically indicated within a week to prevent permanent tendon retraction.
